projector_cue_note: Schema ratified in LIGHTS_SPEC v0.2 §6.8: separate top-level array (v1 players never see it); a later cue on the same projector replaces the earlier one; optional mask {below_m, intensity<=0.4}.
assumptions: LIGHTS_SPEC v0.4 section 6 is normative (v0.3 moved diy_proto_1 and set cantina spot y 2.85; v0.4 moved the cantina spots to z 5.6); values tagged 'LIGHTS_SPEC v0.2 §6.x' come from it. Everything tagged dex_assumption is Dex's.
Authoring frame = spec frame (rooms.*.to_scene converts to the built scene: hall translate [-2,0,1.5], cantina mirror_x, negate pan on export).
Rooms modeled as boxes; the hall L notch is not modeled. A ray that leaves the hall through z=0 inside the vestibule zone counts as a hit on hall_vestibule (zone boundaries are inclusive).
Projector light is exempt from spot/wash no-go zones (spec §6.5); faces are protected by the §6.8 content mask, which every cantina_proj cue carries.
cantina_proj lens sits 0.05 m under the plate (lens_drop_m); image center = lens height - lens_offset_v * H/2, giving 0.57-2.95 m as in §6.5.

Added cantina targets ent_center_L_hi / R_hi (y 2.5), wall_far_L / R and wall_R_upper / wall_R_corner: with the cone checked, most spec cabinet targets at y 2.35-2.4 are blocked by cantina_ent_front, and diy_proto_1 (tilt max 90 deg) cannot point up at them; it works the right-wall / far-wall band.
Rate 'half' = half bar (2 beats), consistent with the v1 README ('beat' is the fastest rate).
